name: Rasan Information Technology Company
note: Saudi joint-stock company listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 8313; listed 13 June 2024, capital SAR 77.5m). Founded by Moayad, Suliman, Thamer and Ayman Alfallaj (Forbes Middle East, 2023-04-09); chairman Muaiyad Abdullah Alfallaj (Saudi Exchange company profile). Owns the Tameeni insurance platform (the IPO prospectus lists Tameeni Electronic Insurance Brokerage as wholly owned). IPO substantial shareholder Impact46, a private Saudi CMA-licensed fund manager, announced its full exit from Rasan through an accelerated bookbuild on 2025-03-13 (impact46.sa). No state body or state fund found in the chain (searched 2026-10-03).
